description: This source file implements a command-line utility to send UDP broadcast messages for dynamically adjusting log levels of components in an RDK-based system. It includes functions for validating log levels and module names, constructs a UDP packet with specific signatures, and sends it to a broadcast address.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the command-line utility.

methods.name: validate_loglevel
methods.description: Validates and converts a log level string to a corresponding internal constant, supporting negation with '~'.

methods.name: validate_module_name
methods.description: Checks if the given module name exists in /etc/debug.ini.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that processes command-line arguments, constructs a UDP packet, and sends it to update log levels.
